FP, FS and FGŚP share that base. • Accident insurance: 1.67% for employers with up to 9 insured; larger employers pay 0.67-3.33% by activity. • Health insurance (9%) is paid by the employee, so it is not an employer cost. • Sp. z o.o. formed at a notary; the online S24 route needs a Polish e-ID. • Formation service: EUR 1,450 + EUR 350 for a corporate shareholder, converted at about 4.25 PLN/EUR. • Opening a bank account for a foreign-owned company takes 3-4 months or more (Grant Thornton). • ZUS may add a fee of up to 100% of unpaid contributions;
